pages.brief: Ned the duckling digging with his beak in a gravel path.
Ned the duckling pulling a small shiny bottle cap out of gravel, delighted.
Ned the duckling sitting on a path, tapping dirt off a shiny cap with his beak.
Nell the bee landing nearby on a low fence post, watching Ned the duckling.
Ned the duckling and Nell the bee sitting together on a gravel path, a clean cap between them.
Nell the bee holding a clean, shiny cap, delighted, while Ned the duckling looks on proudly.
Ned the duckling and Nell the bee both dozing contentedly side by side on a gravel path.
